duplicates.merged: Duplicate chart retired with an immutable merge record
duplicates.adminOnlyHelp: Only practice administrators can review or merge duplicate patient identities.
duplicates.title: Review duplicate patient identities
duplicates.intro: OpenVPM only suggests same-owner matches. A merge is permitted when the retiring chart has no clinical, medication, controlled, financial, or other retained history.
duplicates.warning: Never merge charts merely because pet names match. Confirm the owner, species, DOB, microchip, external identity, and both charts' contents. Historical records are never silently reassigned.
duplicates.emptyHelp: No same-owner charts currently match the duplicate review rules.
duplicates.previewHelp: Preview is recalculated on the server before the merge commits.
duplicates.checking: Checking both charts and their retained history...
duplicates.blocked: Keep both chart identities—this merge is blocked.
duplicates.allowed: The retiring chart has no retained history. Any explicitly listed prospective work will move atomically; an immutable identity event will preserve who merged it, when, and why.
duplicates.reasonPlaceholder: Explain how the duplicate was verified
duplicates.redirectNote: {mergeName} will redirect permanently to the canonical {keepName} chart.

draft.passphraseHelp: Use at least 12 characters and a different passphrase from your OpenVPM password.
